diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted curve rises exponentially to ~0.88 at 6 h and then plateaus near 1.29 from 7–18 h. If that plateau were an optical-saturation artifact hiding continued growth, diluted retained aliquots should back-calculate to much higher OD. At 18 h, 5× dilution gave 0.2563/0.2512/0.2691 (back-calculated 1.282/1.256/1.346; mean 1.295) and 10× dilution gave 0.1461/0.1313/0.1393 (back-calculated 1.461/1.313/1.393; mean 1.389). These bracket the undiluted 18 h reading of 1.2896 and show no large dilution-dependent reveal of extra biomass; the small 10× offset is within plausible dilution/read noise and far below what true continued growth would produce. Thus final-hours biomass is consistent with the undiluted readings, around OD600 ~1.3.
